configuration.scope: Complete standalone conversion pipeline, including adapters and transitive dependencies. No externals or polyfills. Size only; browser execution is not verified for competitors.

entries.strip-markdown: import {remark} from 'remark'; import gfm from 'remark-gfm'; import strip from 'strip-markdown'; const processor=remark().use(gfm).use(strip).freeze(); export default input=>String(processor.processSync(input));
entries.markdown-to-text: import module from 'markdown-to-text'; const fn=module.default||module; export default input=>fn(input);
